quirks: Path B: the panel calls ViON over SIP directly by IP; the agent speaks and listens in that call (G.711). Use it when the panel tells of a ring only over SIP, or takes no sound over RTSP
A person answering in ViON sees and hears the panel by its RTSP; their own voice reaches the panel only where its camera has a talk channel, else they answer in text or hand the call to the agent
The relays open by the HTTP command; opening by a DTMF code in the call works too, but the code is set in the panel and checked on a panel first
The menu names differ between firmware versions (Account, Phone, Intercom): the step-0 table of the report says what was found on the owner's panel
